summary: Iteration 3 re-verification: both iteration-2 bugs fixed and the new optional issue_date feature works. Ran 33 backend tests total — 21 existing auth/isolation tests (test_auth_fisiomanager.py) plus 12 new regression tests (test_bugfixes_and_issue_date.py). ALL 33 PASSING (100%). Verified: (1) BUG FIX 1 — POST /api/invoices/confirm now succeeds for n=1, 3, 5, 7 and 10 appointments in different months (Feb–Jun 2026); the MergedCell skip in invoice_generator.py works and every generated xlsx opens cleanly with openpyxl. (2) BUG FIX 2 — POST /api/auth/apple returns 401 (not 500) for 'not.a.valid.jwt', 'garbage', and '@@@.@@@.@@@' (bad base64 header). auth.py:_verify_apple now wraps header/JWK extraction in try/except. (3) NEW FEATURE issue_date — with issue_date='2026-07-15' the response.issue_date matches and the generated xlsx B8 cell contains 2026-07-15 (verified via openpyxl datetime cell); when omitted it falls back to today's ISO date; 'not-a-date', '15/07/2026', '2026-13-40', '2026-02-30' all return 400. Existing flows unaffected: register/login/logout, /auth/me, 401 on missing/bad token, cross-user isolation (patients/appointments/settings/invoices/voice), per-user invoice numbering (both users independently get #1), and the full 527€ April-2026 flow still produces valid xlsx+PDF. Note: test_fisiomanager.py (the pre-auth legacy suite) shows 20 failures/7 errors because it never sends Bearer tokens — those are expected and superseded by test_auth_fisiomanager.py; recommend deleting or auth-migrating it.

minor.issue: issue_date="" (empty string) is treated as "not provided" (falsy check on payload.issue_date) and silently falls back to today. Not a spec violation (spec only requires 'not-a-date' -> 400) but inconsistent with other invalid strings. Consider changing `if payload.issue_date:` to `if payload.issue_date is not None:` so an explicit empty string yields 400.

(carry-over from iter 2, still present) Response Settings.id is set to the authenticated user's opaque user_id. Not a leak of a foreign id but inconsistent with other resources that use their own UUIDs. Consider omitting `id` for the singleton or using a stable value.

Pre-auth test file still present; 20 failed / 7 errored on last run because it never sends Bearer tokens. Superseded by test_auth_fisiomanager.py. Recommend deletion (or migration) to keep `pytest tests/` green.

action_items: (Optional / minor) Change `if payload.issue_date:` -> `if payload.issue_date is not None:` in server.py:invoice_confirm so an explicit empty string is rejected with 400 for consistency.
(Optional cleanup) Delete or auth-migrate /app/backend/tests/test_fisiomanager.py — it is the pre-auth suite and now always fails when run against the auth-gated backend.
(Optional carry-over) Review Settings response id semantics.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py:_verify_apple — header/JWK extraction is now inside try/except; jwt.PyJWTError → HTTPException(401). Verified on 3 malformed inputs.
invoice_generator.py — the leftover-rows clearing loop now `isinstance(cell, MergedCell)` skips read-only merged cells; verified on 1,3,5,7,10 appts.
server.py:invoice_confirm — issue_date parsed with date.fromisoformat and raises HTTPException(400) on ValueError; xlsx generator receives the parsed date so B8 shows the requested date. Good.
server.py:invoice_confirm empty-string falsy-check on payload.issue_date is the only inconsistency (see minor issue).
PublicUser response still correctly excludes password_hash, google_sub, apple_sub, _id, created_at.
